frozen_policy: At frame 0, measured ball forward distance <=2.5524194955825807 m and measured lateral distance in [-0.09402785405516624,0) m enables bounded 0.8 lateral navigation gain; otherwise gain 0. Same SONIC and 0.95 m late-swing actor in both arms.
procedure: For each of 16 fresh courses, run independent parent+actor baseline and independent parent+actor online-policy candidate, one G1 and ball per process, four A6000 workers. Audit report hashes, parent lineage, stage assets, physical contact, bounded command reconstruction and late-swing actions.
fresh_gate: No candidate loss of clean-foot-only contacts, no new >4 m out-of-play, high-quality shots at least one more overall with no per-seed decrease, mean measured reward at least baseline +0.15, at least two actual policy activations. If baseline has any out-of-play course, candidate must rescue at least one.
decision: One-shot unseen exam. On any failure reject and consume these seeds; do not re-tune against them.
